Labels.org.opencontainers.image.description: Tempo 2.10.10 maintainer rebuild with locked security dependencies

review_sample.scan_coverage: Completed full os,library vuln,secret scan; all severities; list-all-pkgs; local scanner exit0, not a future GitHub CI result.
review_sample.native_version_run_context: independent collector runs /tempo -version in exact image with --network none --read-only --cap-drop ALL

technical_basis: Grafana vendor advisory and GitHub GHSA-ffqx-q65f-36jf state that 2.10.3 is fixed, and Trivy reports FixedVersion=2.10.3. This is explicitly their release-range statement, not an unambiguous inference from the CNA affected array. The retained current CNA record instead lists exactly version2.10.3 with status affected and no lessThan boundary; the metadata sources conflict. The technical conclusion relies on verified backport/source/ELF evidence, not on comparing application version numbers.
Main fix bb8ca663 is not an ancestor of this release branch. Official stable backport 4aeafc237b8d9a8d62e45735131e8a89eb741a00 is an ancestor of f317720e (ahead82/behind0).

Exact pinned config.go, s3.go and config_test.go Git blobs equal both official main fix and stable backport blobs. CustomerEncryptionKey uses flagext.Secret, flag registration uses f.Var, and consumer uses String().
Pinned dskit Secret.MarshalYAML returns a redaction marker rather than the plaintext key; upstream includes an exact YAML redaction regression test. No new upstream or business tests were run.

Actual downloaded ELF SHA256 was independently recomputed; native go version -m -json was rederived locally from those bytes and equals cloud-native JSON byte for byte. Main VCS revision is the fixed f317720e; modified=true matches only locked go.mod/go.sum overlays in the exact pinned build recipe.
Actual runtime -version reports 2.10.10/f317720e/go1.27.3. Native module version remains the true v0 pseudo-version; no application or Go module version is rewritten.
Raw scanner Go inventory equals all391 effective native dependency path/version pairs plus main and stdlib. Fresh scan ImageID and DiffIDs equal the actual collected image inspection and materials.

The one raw HIGH is a release-version classification mismatch for this fixed-source ELF. Raw evidence and HIGH stay visible. This conclusion is not a general runtime risk acceptance or an OCI authorization.

Trivy preserves original-layer provenance for unchanged dependencies (layer index12) while main/stdlib/updated dependencies use rebuilt layer17. The exact native inventory and per-module layer indices are bound; no assumption that every dependency originates in the new COPY layer is made.

2026-10-30 independent data refresh: same exact source build-stage bytes, same17 base layers, same original application ELF SHA256/native inventory/runtime-version/Config and3 final COPY design. Genuine tzdata2026f-0+deb12u1 official deb replaces1265 zoneinfo file/link entries; control and md5sums independently compared to that deb. Old3 tzdata advisories disappear in real full Trivy0.75.0; remaining original HIGH1/MEDIUM1/UNKNOWN1 remain visible.

An independently executed no-cache repackaging experiment changes COPY19 digest while keeping package identity fields and3 original OS package provenance records exact. This is source-layer metadata variation, not changed code approval. Only tzdata.Layer is derived from fresh layer index19, cross-bound through actual inspection/materials/scanner metadata as for existing Go package layer checks. ID/Version/Release/Epoch/PURL/UID stay fixed; no other OS package may use this mapping.
run_binding_policy: Future metadata timestamps may produce another ImageID; every run must cross-bind its fresh scan, actual inspection, collected materials, extracted same ELF and rederived identical native identity. Compiler/source/recipe/config/ELF/native drift fails. The review sample ImageID is retained for audit, not inherited as an OCI approval.
gate_boundary: Apply only the exact one reviewed HIGH tuple. Every other HIGH/CRITICAL and every secret blocks; LOW/MEDIUM/UNKNOWN remain visible and counted under the pre-existing HIGH,CRITICAL threshold. Missing/duplicate/changed reviewed finding blocks. Fresh complete raw vuln,secret scan with list-all-pkgs and operational exit0 is supplied by workflow.

advisory_metadata_conflict.resolution_for_this_exact_subject: Verified stable backport4aeafc ancestry, exact fixed-source Git blobs and actual fixed-subject ELF/native/source binding establish the code fix independently of the conflicting range metadata.

evidence_storage_note: The original upstream go.mod is immutable reference text stored as go.mod.source.txt, retaining upstream original path and Git blob/byte hashes in source-receipt.json. It is not a runnable module or Docker COPY input. The real deployment/vendors/tempo/go.mod remains locked to go-jose/v4 v4.1.6 and is checked separately; no scanner exclusion or raw report change is used.
debian_version_binding_note: Three original Debian package provenance records remain unchanged. The genuine tzdata control now identifies2026f-0+deb12u1; all identity fields are frozen from a completed full0.75 scan. Only its Layer is bound to the actual final COPY at index19 because observed build metadata changes its digest across same-payload repackaging. Every new run must cross-bind fresh raw scan, actual image inspection, native materials and ordered DiffIDs; original severity threshold, scan freshness and raw reports remain unchanged.
